description: Answer a question about ILIT (intralymphatic immunotherapy) from the Society’s published questions and answers: what ILIT is, the treatment, evidence and approval, cost and insurance, finding a practitioner, consultations and appointments, the Society, listing criteria. Give a question or keywords; returns the best-matching answers. With no query, returns the topic names. Use it for short factual answers; use search_journal for longer articles.

limit.description: How many answers to return (default 5, max 20).

query.description: A question in plain words, or keywords (e.g. "is ILIT covered by insurance").

topic.description: Optional: restrict to one topic name, as returned when query is empty.

name: answer_question
title: Answer a question about ILIT
